review_scope: Independent follow-up reviews of selected BLOCKED cases after the 200-case analysis
review_method: One selected BLOCKED testcase at a time. Re-read exact source, matching DeepSeek reference, and original GPT record; apply every reopening gate independently; preserve original overlay.

cases.new_evidence_status: No new vendor or product evidence was supplied; this is an independent gate re-check.

cases.re_review_findings: The original BLOCKED decision remains correct. This is more than a package gap: the target field and block geometry, byte encoding, expected value, approved read-only method, and recovery path are undefined. A guessed PMBus/SMBus command or blind scan would not be a valid review procedure.
unresolved_blockers: Field address and current/next block boundaries
Vendor-approved read-only decoder and access path
required_evidence_to_reopen: Vendor layout/specification naming the field and blocks
Validated decoder/tool version and read-only command
Approved recovery and operator confirmation procedure
cases.safety_decision: Do not execute. Do not write, reflash, reset, or blind-scan the PSU interface; preserve BMC/SEL and host evidence.

cases.new_evidence_status: No new PSU identity, firmware image, HPM method, sequence, or recovery evidence was supplied; this is an independent gate re-check.

source_re_read.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Enter BMC ip address into web browser. (Must use "https://<BMC ip>") and enter account/password.
2. Select "Maintenance/HPM firmware update" page.
3. Update the PSU firmware and click the button to do.
4. Wait a minutes and reboot the system. Re-login the web page to ensure the PSU firmware update successfully.
5. Repeat N & N-1 firmware update 5 times.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_re_read.criteria:
1. Login BMC webUI successfully.
2. Find the page.
3. PSU firmware update successfully without issue.
4. SUT can power cycle without issue.

deepseek_reference_re_read.ai_commands: -- PSU firmware upgrade/downgrade is a multi-step flash (place the user-supplied PSU FW image on the DUT, run the vendor/BMC flash command) that resets the PSU; needs the exact image + a maintenance window. After the flash, verify with sudo ipmitool -I lanplus -C 17 -H "$BMC_IP" -U "$BMC_USER" -P "$BMC_PASS" sensor list 2>&1 | grep -iE "psu" and the FW version readback.
deepseek_reference_re_read.ai_logs_output: return FULL ipmitool PSU sensor/FW-version readback after the user completes the PSU FW flash, so the user confirms the new/downgraded FW version is active.

gate_results.exact_target_identity: FAIL: PSU vendor/model/part number/slot, current firmware, and target image identities are not defined by the source.
gate_results.exact_operation_semantics: FAIL: the source names the BMC HPM page but does not define the validated vendor HPM method, image compatibility rules, or flash invocation.
gate_results.parameters_and_acceptance_criteria: FAIL: N/N-1 values, five-cycle ordering, per-cycle target, timing, retry/abort rules, and firmware readback criteria are undefined.
gate_results.dependencies: FAIL: exact signed images, hashes, downgrade authorization, HPM support, maintenance window, and recovery access are not supplied.
gate_results.safety_and_recovery: FAIL: PSU reset/output impact, redundancy topology, controlled power-cycle limits, and failed-flash recovery are not fully defined.
gate_results.evidence_mapping: FAIL: the criteria do not define per-cycle firmware evidence, final version targets, or deterministic recovery evidence.
gate_results.source_reference_conflict_resolution: PASS: DeepSeek correctly flags PARTIAL/image/maintenance dependencies, but its generic readback does not resolve the source gaps.

cases.re_review_findings: The original BLOCKED decision remains correct. This testcase performs a destructive PSU firmware mutation followed by repeated upgrade/downgrade cycles and a SUT power cycle. The source does not identify the hardware, images, exact sequence, HPM method, acceptance evidence, or recovery path. Package availability alone cannot make this safe or deterministic.
unresolved_blockers: Exact PSU identity and slot map
Current and target N/N-1 signed images, hashes, compatibility, and downgrade authorization
Validated HPM method and five-cycle ordering/timing
Power topology, redundancy, maintenance window, and operator approval
Abort, rollback, PSU replacement, and SUT recovery procedure
required_evidence_to_reopen: Documented five-cycle sequence and controlled power-cycle criteria
Qualified operator, maintenance window, redundancy plan, and tested recovery path
Per-cycle readback and final acceptance definition
cases.safety_decision: Do not upload, flash, downgrade, reset, reboot, or power-cycle. Preserve BMC/SEL/host/power evidence and stop on any missing identity, image, redundancy, or recovery input.
